## Summary

Follow-up to #39598, as requested in its review. #39598 has merged, so this PR is now based directly on `main` and contains only its own two commits.

Extends the existing `--fp4-gemm-backend` argument with two ROCm choices for Quark MXFP4 dense linear layers, replacing the `SGLANG_ROCM_USE_AITER_FP4_ASM_GEMM` environment variable.

- Add `aiter` (gfx95 only; AITER CK/ASM `gemm_a4w4` with preshuffled weights and AITER's a4w4 tuned configs) and `triton` (AITER Triton `gemm_afp4wfp4`) to `Fp4GemmRunnerBackend` and the valid choices.
- `--fp4-gemm-backend auto` on ROCm gfx95 picks the GEMM per Quark MXFP4 layer: AITER `gemm_a4w4` when AITER's a4w4 tuned CSV has a row for the layer's (N, K) on this GPU, Triton otherwise. On other ROCm GPUs `auto` resolves to `triton`.
- `aiter` uses the AITER GEMM for every eligible layer (layers with N <= 128 stay on Triton, as in #39598). `aiter` off gfx95, and `aiter`/`triton` off ROCm, raise at startup.
- DeepSeek MLA `kv_b_proj`, which receives the Triton-only fused split + cat tuple, opts out via `requires_triton_mxfp4_gemm` and always uses Triton.
- `QuarkW4A4MXFP4` reads the resolved backend at construction instead of the env var at import.
- `SGLANG_ROCM_USE_AITER_FP4_ASM_GEMM` is deprecated: still honored with a deprecation warning while the flag is `auto`, ignored with a warning when the flag is set explicitly.
- Docs: `server_arguments.mdx`, `quantization.mdx`. Unit tests: `test_quark_mxfp4_asm.py`.

## Testing

CPU only so far: `test_quark_mxfp4_asm.py`, `test_quark_config.py` and `test_quark_utils.py` pass; `--fp4-gemm-backend` accepts `auto`/`aiter`/`triton` and rejects unknown values; pre-commit is clean.

Pending: GPU A/B on Qwen3.8-27B and a DeepSeek smoke test before review.

@rkarhila-amd the GPU runs are done. Results for the PR head (`e105c8b2b4`) on **MI350X** (gfx950), TP1, `amd/Qwen3.8-27B-Quark-AWQ-MXFP4`.

**Setup**
- Image: `amdsiloai/sglang:v0.5.22-rocm724-qwen38-27b-mxfp4-uplift-mono-29102026` (ROCm 7.2.4, torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2; SGLang main `e732f5d41e` plus 14 PRs, among them this one at `8057e336cf`, #39912, #43785 and #47154; AITER nightly `285579b621` plus ROCm/aiter#6874, #6218, #7117 and #7116), with this PR's two changed Python files (`fp4_utils.py`, `quark_w4a4_mxfp4.py`) moved to `e105c8b2b4`. One image for all arms. The image sets `SGLANG_QWEN38_GDN_PREFILL_PROLOGUE_FUSION=1 SGLANG_USE_AITER_UNIFIED_ATTN=1 SGLANG_VIT_ENABLE_CUDA_GRAPH=1`; `SGLANG_ROCM_USE_AITER_FP4_ASM_GEMM` is unset.

- Which GEMM runs (checked on every `QuarkW4A4MXFP4` layer after loading): with `aiter` and `auto`, 256 of the 304 MXFP4 linears use `gemm_a4w4` (asm kernels for prefill; FlyDSL, CK and Triton-preshuffle tuned rows for decode). The 48 GDN `in_proj_ba` layers (N = 96) stay on Triton (N <= 128). With `triton`, 0 of 304. All six (N, K) shapes of this model have tuned rows on gfx950, so `auto` selects the same layers as `aiter` here.

## Accuracy Tests

GSM8K, `python3 -m sglang.test.few_shot_gsm8k --num-questions 200` (5-shot, greedy):

| `--fp4-gemm-backend` | Accuracy | Invalid |
|---|---|---|
| auto | 0.940 | 0.000 |
| aiter | 0.940 | 0.000 |
| triton | 0.940 | 0.000 |

DeepSeek MLA `kv_b_proj`, smoke test with dummy weights (no DeepSeek MXFP4 checkpoint run yet): DeepSeek-R1-MXFP4's config cut to 2 dense layers with R1's TP8 per-GPU shapes, `--load-format dummy --attention-backend aiter`, one server per backend, prompts of 64 and 3000 tokens (two prefill chunks), then a prefix hit.
- With `auto`, `aiter` and `triton`, `kv_b_proj` (N = 4096, K = 512) keeps `requires_triton_mxfp4_gemm` and runs Triton's `fused_gemm_afp4wfp4_split_cat` on the MHA prefill path (the 5-tuple input). The other 10 MXFP4 linears use `gemm_a4w4` under `aiter` and `auto`. All requests succeed.
- Negative control: with the opt-out cleared under `aiter`, the first prefill raises the new `NotImplementedError` (5-tuple input) and the server exits. (4096, 512) has a tuned a4w4 row, so `auto` would pick `gemm_a4w4` for it too. The opt-out is required.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

`python3 -m sglang.bench_serving --backend sglang-oai-chat --request-rate inf --random-range-ratio 0.8`, with warm-up requests equal to the concurrency. The arms ran one at a time on one GPU in the order auto, aiter, triton, triton, aiter, auto. Each value is the mean of an arm's two runs, and every request succeeded in every run. The delta in brackets is auto vs triton.

| Row (dataset, ISL/OSL, concurrency, prompts) | Output tok/s: triton / aiter / auto | Mean TPOT ms | Mean TTFT ms |
|---|---|---|---|
| text, 8192/1024, c16, 96 | 1141 / 1442 / 1441 (+26.3%) | 12.41 / 10.05 / 10.05 (-19.0%) | 1128 / 724 / 731 (-35.2%) |
| text, 8192/1024, c32, 128 | 1575 / 1849 / 1854 (+17.7%) | 17.99 / 15.49 / 15.45 (-14.1%) | 1293 / 1063 / 1054 (-18.5%) |
| text, 8192/1024, c64, 256 | 1810 / 2282 / 2291 (+26.6%) | 32.20 / 25.50 / 25.41 (-21.1%) | 2232 / 1820 / 1809 (-19.0%) |
| text, 8192/1024, c256, 768 | 2348 / 2798 / 2804 (+19.4%) | 95.91 / 80.75 / 80.60 (-16.0%) | 10261 / 8442 / 8405 (-18.1%) |
| text, 60000/600, c4, 32 | 163 / 210 / 210 (+29.1%) | 19.02 / 14.43 / 14.34 (-24.6%) | 2948 / 2484 / 2509 (-14.9%) |
| text, 60000/600, c16, 96 | 229 / 268 / 269 (+17.4%) | 59.49 / 50.85 / 50.56 (-15.0%) | 5169 / 4488 / 4496 (-13.0%) |
| image 768x1024, 1024/64, c16, 96 | 495 / 588 / 582 (+17.7%) | 23.46 / 18.59 / 19.30 (-17.7%) | 489 / 482 / 458 (-6.4%) |
| image 768x1024, 8192/64, c16, 96 | 185 / 228 / 227 (+22.9%) | 50.73 / 32.56 / 35.77 (-29.5%) | 2053 / 2184 / 2007 (-2.3%) |
| image 768x1024, 1024/64, c4, 32 | 255 / 341 / 341 (+33.9%) | 12.09 / 7.97 / 7.75 (-35.9%) | 197 / 207 / 221 (+12.1%) |

Geomean over the 9 rows:

| | Output throughput | Mean TPOT | Mean TTFT |
|---|---|---|---|
| auto vs triton | +23.3% | -21.8% | -13.7% |
| aiter vs triton | +23.3% | -22.5% | -13.0% |
| auto vs aiter | +0.0% | +0.9% | -0.8% |

- auto vs triton and aiter vs triton have the same sign in both rounds on all three metrics. Run-to-run spread (the two runs of one arm): output throughput within 0.9% on the text rows and within 3% on the image rows.
- TTFT: -20% on the text rows. On the two image rows at concurrency 4 and 16 with 64 output tokens, the mean and median TTFT are higher with `aiter`/`auto` (c4 median 220-225 vs 131 ms), while p99 TTFT (307-322 vs 356 ms) and e2e latency (665-667 vs 891 ms) are lower. We have not root-caused this yet.
- `auto` vs `aiter`: within noise on every metric, as expected with identical layer choices.

Kernel time per forward step (torch profiler; FP4 GEMM kernels in brackets):

| Step | triton | aiter | auto |
|---|---|---|---|
| Prefill, 2048 tokens | 68.5 ms (40.0) | 57.3 ms (30.3) | 57.5 ms (30.2) |
| Decode, batch 1 | 9.7 ms (6.0) | 5.5 ms (2.75) | 5.5 ms (2.75) |
| Decode, batch 32 | 10.2 ms (4.4) | 9.2 ms (4.5) | 9.3 ms (4.5) |

At batch 1 the AITER GEMMs read the MXFP4 weights at 59% of HBM peak, against 27% for Triton's split-K. At batch 32 the GEMM time is on par. The step gain there comes from fusions that only apply on the AITER GEMM path in this image: #47154's fused MXFP4 input quantization and #43785's qkvz+ba packing. On `main` without those PRs, the `triton` vs `aiter` decode gap at batch 32 would be smaller.

Could you take another look and, if it looks good to you, approve it so the "changes requested" clears? Then I'll mark it ready for review and ask the code owners.

I appreciate removing obscure env variables and adding clear command line options.

Let me know when you have finished the GPU test runs.

Consider if all of the new tests are needed, or can old ones be reappropriated.
I can't believe we haven't had these choices for AMD hardware earlier!

Or gfx1250 if not now at least in very near future?
Having these ifs based on architecture in a million places will backfire when more architectures support mxfp4. This should be checked against aiter directly, but that might be hard. How about having mxfp4_supported() function or variable mxfp4_supported variable defined at the top of the file for future maintainability?

- `is_mxfp4_gemm_supported()` replaces the gfx95 checks (see the thread on `fp4_utils.py`).
- Tests folded: one table for the backend resolution, and the existing narrow-layer test reuses the per-layer helper (22 tests instead of 24, same cases).
- The docs build error behind the red lint check (`N <= 128` in the MDX).
- Title in the required format.

GPU runs: this PR has been in the Qwen3.8-27B MI355X images we test since 10-27, but the isolated A/B (`--fp4-gemm-backend aiter` vs `triton` vs `auto` on Qwen3.8-27B) and the DeepSeek smoke test are not done yet. I'll post them here when they are.

@rkarhila-amd the GPU runs are done. Results for the PR head (`e105c8b2b4`) on **MI350X** (gfx950), TP1, `amd/Qwen3.8-27B-Quark-AWQ-MXFP4`.

**Setup**
- Image: `amdsiloai/sglang:v0.5.22-rocm724-qwen38-27b-mxfp4-uplift-mono-29102026` (ROCm 7.2.4, torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2; SGLang main `e732f5d41e` plus 14 PRs, among them this one at `8057e336cf`, #39912, #43785 and #47154; AITER nightly `285579b621` plus ROCm/aiter#6874, #6218, #7117 and #7116), with this PR's two changed Python files (`fp4_utils.py`, `quark_w4a4_mxfp4.py`) moved to `e105c8b2b4`. One image for all arms. The image sets `SGLANG_QWEN38_GDN_PREFILL_PROLOGUE_FUSION=1 SGLANG_USE_AITER_UNIFIED_ATTN=1 SGLANG_VIT_ENABLE_CUDA_GRAPH=1`; `SGLANG_ROCM_USE_AITER_FP4_ASM_GEMM` is unset.
- Server, identical in every arm except the last flag: `SGLANG_USE_AITER=1 SAFETENSORS_FAST_GPU=1 python3 -m sglang.launch_server --model-path amd/Qwen3.8-27B-Quark-AWQ-MXFP4 --tp-size 1 --trust-remote-code --quantization quark --attention-backend aiter --kv-cache-dtype fp8_e4m3 --chunked-prefill-size 16384 --context-length 139264 --disable-radix-cache --max-running-requests 256 --mem-fraction-static 0.9 --model-loader-extra-config '{"enable_multithread_load": true}' --reasoning-parser qwen3 --tool-call-parser qwen3_coder --watchdog-timeout 12000 --fp4-gemm-backend {auto|aiter|triton}`
- Which GEMM runs (checked on every `QuarkW4A4MXFP4` layer after loading): with `aiter` and `auto`, 256 of the 304 MXFP4 linears use `gemm_a4w4` (asm kernels for prefill; FlyDSL, CK and Triton-preshuffle tuned rows for decode). The 48 GDN `in_proj_ba` layers (N = 96) stay on Triton (N <= 128). With `triton`, 0 of 304. All six (N, K) shapes of this model have tuned rows on gfx950, so `auto` selects the same layers as `aiter` here.

## Accuracy Tests

GSM8K, `python3 -m sglang.test.few_shot_gsm8k --num-questions 200` (5-shot, greedy):

| `--fp4-gemm-backend` | Accuracy | Invalid |
|---|---|---|
| auto | 0.940 | 0.000 |
| aiter | 0.940 | 0.000 |
| triton | 0.940 | 0.000 |

DeepSeek MLA `kv_b_proj`, smoke test with dummy weights (no DeepSeek MXFP4 checkpoint run yet): DeepSeek-R1-MXFP4's config cut to 2 dense layers with R1's TP8 per-GPU shapes, `--load-format dummy --attention-backend aiter`, one server per backend, prompts of 64 and 3000 tokens (two prefill chunks), then a prefix hit.
- With `auto`, `aiter` and `triton`, `kv_b_proj` (N = 4096, K = 512) keeps `requires_triton_mxfp4_gemm` and runs Triton's `fused_gemm_afp4wfp4_split_cat` on the MHA prefill path (the 5-tuple input). The other 10 MXFP4 linears use `gemm_a4w4` under `aiter` and `auto`. All requests succeed.
- Negative control: with the opt-out cleared under `aiter`, the first prefill raises the new `NotImplementedError` (5-tuple input) and the server exits. (4096, 512) has a tuned a4w4 row, so `auto` would pick `gemm_a4w4` for it too. The opt-out is required.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

`python3 -m sglang.bench_serving --backend sglang-oai-chat --request-rate inf --random-range-ratio 0.8`, with warm-up requests equal to the concurrency. The arms ran one at a time on one GPU in the order auto, aiter, triton, triton, aiter, auto. Each value is the mean of an arm's two runs, and every request succeeded in every run. The delta in brackets is auto vs triton.

| Row (dataset, ISL/OSL, concurrency, prompts) | Output tok/s: triton / aiter / auto | Mean TPOT ms | Mean TTFT ms |
|---|---|---|---|
| text, 8192/1024, c16, 96 | 1141 / 1442 / 1441 (+26.3%) | 12.41 / 10.05 / 10.05 (-19.0%) | 1128 / 724 / 731 (-35.2%) |
| text, 8192/1024, c32, 128 | 1575 / 1849 / 1854 (+17.7%) | 17.99 / 15.49 / 15.45 (-14.1%) | 1293 / 1063 / 1054 (-18.5%) |
| text, 8192/1024, c64, 256 | 1810 / 2282 / 2291 (+26.6%) | 32.20 / 25.50 / 25.41 (-21.1%) | 2232 / 1820 / 1809 (-19.0%) |
| text, 8192/1024, c256, 768 | 2348 / 2798 / 2804 (+19.4%) | 95.91 / 80.75 / 80.60 (-16.0%) | 10261 / 8442 / 8405 (-18.1%) |
| text, 60000/600, c4, 32 | 163 / 210 / 210 (+29.1%) | 19.02 / 14.43 / 14.34 (-24.6%) | 2948 / 2484 / 2509 (-14.9%) |
| text, 60000/600, c16, 96 | 229 / 268 / 269 (+17.4%) | 59.49 / 50.85 / 50.56 (-15.0%) | 5169 / 4488 / 4496 (-13.0%) |
| image 768x1024, 1024/64, c16, 96 | 495 / 588 / 582 (+17.7%) | 23.46 / 18.59 / 19.30 (-17.7%) | 489 / 482 / 458 (-6.4%) |
| image 768x1024, 8192/64, c16, 96 | 185 / 228 / 227 (+22.9%) | 50.73 / 32.56 / 35.77 (-29.5%) | 2053 / 2184 / 2007 (-2.3%) |
| image 768x1024, 1024/64, c4, 32 | 255 / 341 / 341 (+33.9%) | 12.09 / 7.97 / 7.75 (-35.9%) | 197 / 207 / 221 (+12.1%) |

Geomean over the 9 rows:

| | Output throughput | Mean TPOT | Mean TTFT |
|---|---|---|---|
| auto vs triton | +23.3% | -21.8% | -13.7% |
| aiter vs triton | +23.3% | -22.5% | -13.0% |
| auto vs aiter | +0.0% | +0.9% | -0.8% |

- TTFT: -20% on the text rows. We have not root-caused this yet.
- `auto` vs `aiter`: within noise on every metric, as expected with identical layer choices.

Kernel time per forward step (torch profiler; FP4 GEMM kernels in brackets):

| Step | triton | aiter | auto |
|---|---|---|---|
| Prefill, 2048 tokens | 68.5 ms (40.0) | 57.3 ms (30.3) | 57.5 ms (30.2) |
| Decode, batch 1 | 9.7 ms (6.0) | 5.5 ms (2.75) | 5.5 ms (2.75) |
| Decode, batch 32 | 10.2 ms (4.4) | 9.2 ms (4.5) | 9.3 ms (4.5) |

The step gain there comes from fusions that only apply on the AITER GEMM path in this image: #47154's fused MXFP4 input quantization and #43785's qkvz+ba packing. On `main` without those PRs, the `triton` vs `aiter` decode gap at batch 32 would be smaller.
